name: Hints of a New Plague?
summary: Kinelory is ready to go down to the farm, and asks you to come with her. She fears the undead may harm Hillsbrad while they wait. You are needed to see her safely back.

sections.title: Watching Kinelory's Back
sections.body: Kinelory is ready to act after the earlier steps of the investigation. She asks you to go with her down to the farm, then return safely to Quae. The people of Hillsbrad need her protected.

sections.title: A Safe Return
sections.body: Quae thanks you when Kinelory returns. Quae admits she hoped Kinelory would not be too much of a handful. Kinelory is friendly, yet deadly to her enemies.

faq.q: Who sends you on this escort?
aliases: who starts hints of a new plague 4
faq.answer: Kinelory asks you to go with her when she is ready to set out.

faq.q: Where does Kinelory need to go?
faq.answer: Kinelory goes down to a farm, then returns to Quae.

faq.q: Who do you report to when finished?
faq.answer: You report to Quae once Kinelory has returned to her.

faq.q: What came right before this part of the investigation?
faq.answer: The third part of Hints of a New Plague? leads into this part of the investigation.
The investigation continues with its fifth part.
Kinelory needs protection so she can return safely while the undead may harm the people of Hillsbrad.
